name: Embedded Firmware Serial Console & Debugger
description: Web terminal and serial console for embedded firmware debugging with real-time streaming, adjustable baud rates, hex dump view, multi-device WebSerial support, automated firmware download & power-cycle boot capture workflow, 60-month IndexedDB session retention, SQLite/offline disk exporters, real-time live console sharing, and an ARM Cortex simulator with Das U-Boot command line interface (CLI), C compiler, dynamic AAPCS function execution (go/call), memory read/write (md/mw/cp), and hardware datapath visualizer.
